title: 第14章 文化宣传部第15章 文化与宣传1
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
林恩不断的公布他接下来的政策，人们也是终于安心了一点。
原本一起住的宿舍，吃大锅饭依旧保存不变，生产组也还是那样。
林恩的废奴不是一口气把全部废除的，而逐步进行的。
林恩可不会让人闲着，这个时代的人不懂林恩读过的书。
商君书，君主论，都在说不能让百姓闲着。
林恩有超越时代的目光，即使他想让其他人过的好，也不能在现在停下，必须要加速发展。
修建好城墙后，林恩决定开始他的超前发展思维，统一思想。
只有统一思想，才能让一个群体爆发出惊人的潜力。
比如说铁血十字国，高卢，这些近代就是因为民族主义而强大的。
卢斯联邦，赛里斯，因为红色思想强大。
樱花则是因为军国主义。
剩余的其他国家，带鹰和它的儿子鹰酱，这两个家伙的人民的战斗力一言难尽，不如樱花这个穷逼帝国主义，也不如赛里斯这个一穷二白国家，更不如铁血十字的战斗力。
他们靠什么？
靠有钱！
打四个心脏的时候就是这样。
其他国家：“我有逆天buff。”
鹰酱：“我开局200民工。”
其他国家：“我减坦克造价，步枪造价。”
鹰酱：“我开局200民工。”
其他国家：“我民族精神加攻防。”

鹰酱：“我开局200民工。”
林恩要把思想工作做好，才能确保自己未来的强大。
现在的林恩，已经通过吸收蓝星上四条路线融合出来了一个抽象的政体。
首先就是确定自己的政体的核心利益群体，核心思想。
林恩需要其他种族的力量，所以不能玩极端黑线。
林恩不能被分权，蓝线只能走一点点。
林恩需要保证基层控制，红线也必须走。
p社战犯又不是真战犯。
p社玩家分两种，一种是只想自己的势力强大起来，这类玩家心善的时候会让人民过上好日子。
另一种人是真战犯，单纯的就是为了玩的玩家。
林恩还是很理性的，这里是现实，不是为所欲为的地方，要符合客观规律。
单纯的作恶，那就是真愚蠢，一点政治知识和心理知识都不明白。
实在不懂就去读读历史，真那样做下一秒就被吊死。
就算没有，也会被背刺。
所以林恩要做的是第一种，做一些进步的事情，即使别人不理解。
最终林恩确定了自己要建立的东西。
宣传民族主义，一个名为阿宁斯贝人的民族，拥有各个种族的民族。
只要你认同阿宁斯贝的思想，你就是阿宁斯贝人。
宣传集体荣耀。
每当讲起带鹰帝国的荣耀，累了一天，工作了16小时的工厂工人都会骄傲的抬起自己的胸膛。

宣传个人崇拜思想。
林恩大人将带领大家过上好日子。
宣传科学精神，研究精神，清贫过日，教育为重，为了集体。
content_en:
Lin En kept announcing his next policies, and people finally felt a little more at ease.
The dormitory where we originally lived together and the big pot meal remained unchanged, and the production team remained the same.
Lynn's abolition of slavery was not abolished all at once, but carried out step by step.
Lin En doesn't let people sit idle. People of this era don't understand the books Lin En has read.
The Book of Shang Jun and The Theory of the King all say that the people should not be left idle.
Lynn has a vision beyond the times. Even if he wants others to live a good life, he cannot stop now and must accelerate development.
After building the city wall, Lin En decided to start his forward-thinking development and unify his thinking.
Only by uniting our minds can a group unleash its amazing potential.
For example, the Iron Cross and Gaul were powerful in modern times because of nationalism.
Luce Federation, Siris, because red ideas are powerful.
Sakura is because of militarism.
The fighting power of the people of the other remaining countries, Dai Ying and his son Takajia, is hard to describe. They are not as good as Sakura, a poor imperialist country, nor are they as good as Seris, a poor and white country, nor are they as good as the fighting power of the Iron-Blooded Cross.
What do they rely on?
By having money!
That's what happens when you hit four hearts.
Other countries: "I have a heaven-defying buff."
Yingjiang: "I start with 200 migrant workers."
Other countries: "I will reduce the cost of tanks and rifles."
Yingjiang: "I start with 200 migrant workers."
Other countries: "Our national spirit adds offense and defense."
Yingjiang: "I start with 200 migrant workers."
Lin En must do a good job in ideological work to ensure his future strength.
Now Lin En has merged into an abstract political system by absorbing the four routes on Blue Star.
The first is to determine the core interest groups and core ideas of your own political system.
Linn needs the power of other races, so he can't play the extreme black line.
Lynn can't be decentralized, and the blue line can only go a little bit.
Lynn needs to ensure grassroots control, and red lines must be walked.
P Society war criminals are not real war criminals.
There are two types of P Club players. One type just wants to make their own power stronger. When these players are kind-hearted, they will make the people live a good life.
The other kind of people are real war criminals, players who are just playing for fun.
Lin En is still very rational. This is reality, not a place to do whatever you want. It must comply with objective laws.
Simply doing evil is really stupid, and you don’t understand any political or psychological knowledge.
If you really don’t understand, just read history. If you do that, you’ll be hanged the next second.
Even if he doesn't, he will be stabbed in the back.
So what Lynn has to do is the first, do something progressive, even if others don't understand it.
Eventually Lynn settled on what he wanted to build.
Propaganda of nationalism, a people called the Aninsbeis, a people of all races.
As long as you agree with Aningsby's thoughts, you are an Aningsby person.
Promote collective glory.
Whenever the glory of the Eagle Empire is mentioned, factory workers who have worked for 16 hours after a tiring day will raise their chests with pride.
Promote the idea of ​​personality cult.
Master Lin will lead everyone to live a good life.
Promote the spirit of science and research, live in poverty, put education first, and serve the collective.
